run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to compare a submission CSV against ground truth and print accuracy metrics
test_load_data: test the load_data function to load ground truth and submission CSV files into pandas DataFrames
test_validate_submission: test the validate_submission function to check that a submission has the correct columns and row count
test_calculate_metrics: test the calculate_metrics function to compute accuracy score between ground truth and predicted survival values
refactor_evaluate: refactor the evaluate function to support additional metrics beyond accuracy for the Titanic dataset
